subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should maintainers accept these specific updated external action revisions for workflows that receive GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and an OpenAI API key?
rationale: The patch shape is conventional, but selecting new third-party executable revisions for credentialed workflows is a trust-boundary decision that cannot be settled by dependency metadata or ordinary source review alone.

options.title: Audit and merge after exact-head proof
options.body: Verify the selected action revisions and their release provenance, wait for the exact-head workflow matrix, then rebase and merge if the credentialed paths complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Land only independently approved low-risk workflow action updates and keep the credential-consuming action revisions in a separately audited PR.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or defer the broad Dependabot batch if no owner is prepared to approve the updated credentialed action code.

recommendation.title: Audit and merge after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Verify the selected action revisions and their release provenance, wait for the exact-head workflow matrix, then rebase and merge if the credentialed paths complete successfully.
